sentences.text: Te estoy muy agradecido.
sentences.translation: I'm very grateful to you.

sentences.text: Estamos agradecidos por todo.
sentences.translation: We're grateful for everything.

sentences.text: Mi abuela quedó muy agradecida por la visita.
sentences.translation: My grandmother was very thankful for the visit.

notes: película de terror = horror film.

sentences.text: En el cine, lo que más me gusta es el terror.
sentences.translation: At the cinema, what I like most is horror.

sentences.text: Ese niño es el terror del barrio.
sentences.translation: That kid is the terror of the neighbourhood.

sentences.text: Aquellos fueron años de terror.
sentences.translation: Those were years of terror.

sentences.text: Mis padres hicieron muchos sacrificios por nosotros.
sentences.translation: My parents made a lot of sacrifices for us.

sentences.text: Mudarse al extranjero fue un gran sacrificio para ella.
sentences.translation: Moving abroad was a big sacrifice for her.

sentences.text: Por sus hijos, aceptó el sacrificio de dejar su carrera.
sentences.translation: For her children, she accepted the sacrifice of giving up her career.

sentences.text: Las fotos muestran la destrucción de la ciudad.
sentences.translation: The photos show the destruction of the city.

sentences.text: Nadie esperaba tanta destrucción.
sentences.translation: Nobody expected so much destruction.

sentences.text: Tras la tormenta, solo vimos destrucción.
sentences.translation: After the storm, we saw only destruction.

sentences.text: Escribí un texto corto sobre mi familia.
sentences.translation: I wrote a short text about my family.

sentences.text: Lee estos dos textos para mañana.
sentences.translation: Read these two texts for tomorrow.

sentences.text: El texto del examen era muy largo.
sentences.translation: The text in the exam was very long.

sentences.text: Nuestro equipo va primero en la liga.
sentences.translation: Our team is top of the league.

sentences.text: Mi sobrino juega en una liga infantil.
sentences.translation: My nephew plays in a children's league.

sentences.text: En las ligas pequeñas también hay buenos jugadores.
sentences.translation: There are good players in the small leagues too.

sentences.text: Los niños corren colina abajo.
sentences.translation: The children run down the hill.

sentences.text: Mi casa está detrás de esa colina.
sentences.translation: My house is behind that hill.

sentences.text: Por aquí todo son colinas y campos.
sentences.translation: Around here it's all hills and fields.

notes: sano y salvo = safe and sound.

sentences.text: El bebé nació sano.
sentences.translation: The baby was born healthy.

sentences.text: La fruta es muy sana.
sentences.translation: Fruit is very healthy.

sentences.text: Mis hijos están sanos y fuertes.
sentences.translation: My children are healthy and strong.

sentences.text: Mi familia es muy musical: todos tocan algo.
sentences.translation: My family is very musical: they all play something.

sentences.text: Toco varios instrumentos musicales.
sentences.translation: I play several musical instruments.

sentences.text: ¿Qué estilo musical te gusta más?
sentences.translation: What style of music do you like best?

notes: pastor alemán = German shepherd (dog).

sentences.text: El pastor cuida de sus ovejas.
sentences.translation: The shepherd looks after his sheep.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo fue pastor de joven.
sentences.translation: My grandfather was a shepherd when he was young.

sentences.text: Los pastores pasan el verano en el monte.
sentences.translation: The shepherds spend the summer up in the mountains.

sentences.text: Tenemos un pastor alemán.
sentences.translation: We have a German shepherd.

gloss: battery (of a phone, a car); drums
notes: Small batteries for a remote or a clock are pilas.

sentences.text: Me queda poca batería.
sentences.translation: My battery is almost dead.

sentences.text: Compré dos baterías nuevas para la cámara.
sentences.translation: I bought two new batteries for the camera.

sentences.text: Mi hermano toca la batería en un grupo.
sentences.translation: My brother plays the drums in a band.

gloss: figure (a shape or a person); figurine

sentences.text: Vimos una figura oscura al fondo de la calle.
sentences.translation: We saw a dark figure at the end of the street.

sentences.text: Mi tía tiene figuras de cristal en el salón.
sentences.translation: My aunt has glass figurines in the living room.

sentences.text: Él era una gran figura del teatro.
sentences.translation: He was a great figure in the theatre.

notes: callejón sin salida = dead end.

sentences.text: No vayas por ese callejón tan oscuro.
sentences.translation: Don't go down that dark alley.

sentences.text: El barrio antiguo tiene muchos callejones.
sentences.translation: The old quarter has lots of alleys.

sentences.text: Estamos en un callejón sin salida.
sentences.translation: We're at a dead end.

sentences.text: Tiene buena técnica, pero le falta fuerza.
sentences.translation: She has good technique, but she lacks strength.

sentences.text: Aprendí una técnica para dormir mejor.
sentences.translation: I learned a technique for sleeping better.

sentences.text: Estas técnicas de pesca son muy antiguas.
sentences.translation: These fishing methods are very old.

sentences.text: Te noto cansado.
sentences.translation: You seem tired to me.

sentences.text: Nadie notó el cambio.
sentences.translation: Nobody noticed the change.

sentences.text: ¿Has notado algo raro en la casa?
sentences.translation: Have you noticed anything strange in the house?

sentences.text: Hoy no llevo nada de maquillaje.
sentences.translation: I'm not wearing any make-up today.

sentences.text: Se quitó el maquillaje antes de dormir.
sentences.translation: She took off her make-up before going to sleep.

sentences.text: Se pone poco maquillaje para ir a trabajar.
sentences.translation: She wears very little make-up to work.

gloss: to launch; to bring out (a new product); to fire, to throw hard
notes: For everyday throwing, tirar is more common.

sentences.text: La empresa lanzará un teléfono nuevo en otoño.
sentences.translation: The company will launch a new phone in the autumn.

sentences.text: Lanzaron fuegos artificiales a medianoche.
sentences.translation: They set off fireworks at midnight.

sentences.text: El enemigo lanzó un ataque por la noche.
sentences.translation: The enemy launched an attack at night.

gloss: police (as in police car, police work)

sentences.text: Nos paró un control policial en la carretera.
sentences.translation: A police checkpoint stopped us on the road.

sentences.text: La operación policial duró toda la noche.
sentences.translation: The police operation lasted all night.

sentences.text: Hoy hay mucha presencia policial en el centro.
sentences.translation: There are a lot of police in the centre today.

sentences.text: El proyecto está en su última fase.
sentences.translation: The project is in its final stage.

sentences.text: Es solo una fase, ya se le pasará.
sentences.translation: It's just a phase; she'll grow out of it.

sentences.text: Lo haremos en dos fases.
sentences.translation: We'll do it in two stages.

notes: Informal. una porquería de coche = a lousy car.

sentences.text: Deja de comer porquerías.
sentences.translation: Stop eating junk food.

sentences.text: Tira esas porquerías, que no sirven para nada.
sentences.translation: Throw out that junk; it's no use.

sentences.text: Me compré una porquería de coche.
sentences.translation: I bought myself a lousy car.

gloss: to overcome, to get over; to pass (a test); to beat

sentences.text: Nadie supera a mi padre en la cocina.
sentences.translation: Nobody beats my father in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Le costó mucho superar la muerte de su padre.
sentences.translation: It was very hard for her to get over her father's death.

sentences.text: Superamos todas las pruebas.
sentences.translation: We passed all the tests.

sentences.text: Por fin me han subido el sueldo.
sentences.translation: They've finally given me a pay rise.

sentences.text: Con este sueldo no llego a fin de mes.
sentences.translation: On this salary I can't make it to the end of the month.

sentences.text: En esta empresa los sueldos son bajos.
sentences.translation: Pay at this company is low.

sentences.text: Ese testimonio fue clave en el juicio.
sentences.translation: That testimony was key at the trial.

sentences.text: El juez escuchó el testimonio de la vecina.
sentences.translation: The judge listened to the neighbour's testimony.

sentences.text: Los testimonios no cuentan la misma historia.
sentences.translation: The witnesses' accounts don't tell the same story.

sentences.text: Los asientos del tren son incómodos.
sentences.translation: The seats on the train are uncomfortable.

sentences.text: Fue un silencio muy incómodo.
sentences.translation: It was a really awkward silence.

sentences.text: Sus preguntas me ponen incómoda.
sentences.translation: His questions make me uncomfortable.

notes: For the side of a street or a table, use lado.

sentences.text: La bala le entró por el costado.
sentences.translation: The bullet went in through his side.

sentences.text: Al correr me duele el costado.
sentences.translation: When I run, my side hurts.

sentences.text: El caballo tenía heridas en los costados.
sentences.translation: The horse had wounds on its flanks.

gloss: to turn off, to switch off; to put out (a fire)

sentences.text: Apago el ordenador a las seis.
sentences.translation: I switch off the computer at six.

sentences.text: ¿Has apagado el horno?
sentences.translation: Have you turned off the oven?

sentences.text: Los bomberos apagaron el incendio en una hora.
sentences.translation: The firefighters put out the fire in an hour.

sentences.text: Antes del viaje tengo que sacar el pasaporte.
sentences.translation: Before the trip I have to get a passport.

sentences.text: Nos pidieron los pasaportes en la frontera.
sentences.translation: They asked for our passports at the border.

sentences.text: Para viajar a ese país no necesitas pasaporte.
sentences.translation: You don't need a passport to travel to that country.

sentences.text: Perdió a su madre en la infancia.
sentences.translation: He lost his mother in childhood.

sentences.text: Somos amigos desde la infancia.
sentences.translation: We've been friends since childhood.

sentences.text: Mi muñeca favorita de la infancia sigue en casa de mis padres.
sentences.translation: My favourite doll from childhood is still at my parents' house.

notes: In Spain, a mediodía often means at lunchtime, around two.

sentences.text: Quedamos mañana a mediodía.
sentences.translation: Let's meet tomorrow at midday.

sentences.text: A mediodía hace demasiado calor para salir.
sentences.translation: At midday it's too hot to go out.

sentences.text: Mi padre viene a comer a casa al mediodía.
sentences.translation: My father comes home for lunch at midday.

notes: I form: reconozco.

sentences.text: Mi abuela ya no reconoce a nadie.
sentences.translation: My grandmother doesn't recognise anyone any more.

sentences.text: No te reconocí con ese pelo.
sentences.translation: I didn't recognise you with that hair.

sentences.text: Reconozco su voz en cualquier sitio.
sentences.translation: I'd recognise her voice anywhere.

sentences.text: Esta botella es de plástico.
sentences.translation: This bottle is made of plastic.

sentences.text: Separamos el plástico del resto de la basura.
sentences.translation: We separate the plastic from the rest of the rubbish.

sentences.text: Hay plásticos por toda la playa.
sentences.translation: There's plastic all over the beach.

sentences.text: Mi padre se ha dejado barba.
sentences.translation: My father has grown a beard.

sentences.text: En el pueblo todos los hombres llevaban barbas largas.
sentences.translation: In the village all the men had long beards.

sentences.text: Te está buscando un hombre con barba.
sentences.translation: A man with a beard is looking for you.

notes: los Reyes Magos = the Three Kings, who bring presents on 6 January.

sentences.text: En la fiesta había un mago.
sentences.translation: There was a magician at the party.

sentences.text: En el cuento, el viejo mago ayuda al príncipe.
sentences.translation: In the story, the old wizard helps the prince.

sentences.text: Los Reyes Magos traen regalos a los niños.
sentences.translation: The Three Kings bring presents to the children.

sentences.text: En otoño caen las hojas.
sentences.translation: In autumn the leaves fall.

sentences.text: ¿Me das una hoja en blanco?
sentences.translation: Can you give me a blank sheet of paper?

sentences.text: Este árbol no pierde las hojas en invierno.
sentences.translation: This tree doesn't lose its leaves in winter.

gloss: to find (formal, used in the news); hallarse = to be located
notes: In everyday talk, encontrar is much more common.

sentences.text: Los heridos se hallan en estado grave.
sentences.translation: The injured are in a serious condition.

sentences.text: Es el barco más antiguo hallado en España.
sentences.translation: It's the oldest ship ever found in Spain.

sentences.text: El hotel se halla en pleno centro.
sentences.translation: The hotel is located right in the centre.

sentences.text: Aquí usamos aceite, no mantequilla.
sentences.translation: Here we use oil, not butter.

sentences.text: Esta tarta lleva mucha mantequilla.
sentences.translation: This cake has a lot of butter in it.

sentences.text: Saca la mantequilla de la nevera.
sentences.translation: Take the butter out of the fridge.

gloss: to deal with, to cope with (something hard)

sentences.text: Cada día lidio con clientes difíciles.
sentences.translation: Every day I deal with difficult customers.

sentences.text: Ha tenido que lidiar con muchos problemas.
sentences.translation: She has had to cope with a lot of problems.

sentences.text: Ya no sé cómo lidiar con él.
sentences.translation: I don't know how to deal with him any more.

sentences.text: La sentencia sale la semana que viene.
sentences.translation: The ruling comes out next week.

sentences.text: La familia no está de acuerdo con la sentencia.
sentences.translation: The family doesn't agree with the ruling.

sentences.text: Las sentencias de este juez son muy duras.
sentences.translation: This judge's sentences are very harsh.

sentences.text: Esta playa es ideal para los niños.
sentences.translation: This beach is ideal for children.

sentences.text: No existe la pareja ideal.
sentences.translation: There's no such thing as the ideal partner.

sentences.text: Las condiciones eran ideales para navegar.
sentences.translation: Conditions were ideal for sailing.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo vive en una residencia.
sentences.translation: My grandfather lives in a care home.

sentences.text: En verano las residencias de estudiantes están vacías.
sentences.translation: In summer the student halls are empty.

sentences.text: Necesito el permiso de residencia para trabajar.
sentences.translation: I need a residence permit to work.

gloss: frankly; really, truly (francamente mal = really bad)

sentences.text: Hablando francamente, ese plan no va a funcionar.
sentences.translation: Frankly speaking, that plan isn't going to work.

sentences.text: Te lo digo francamente: no me gusta tu novio.
sentences.translation: I'll tell you frankly: I don't like your boyfriend.

sentences.text: El servicio del hotel fue francamente malo.
sentences.translation: The hotel service was frankly awful.

sentences.text: El rey tenía mil guerreros.
sentences.translation: The king had a thousand warriors.

sentences.text: El viejo guerrero luchó hasta el final.
sentences.translation: The old warrior fought to the end.

sentences.text: Mi madre es una auténtica guerrera.
sentences.translation: My mother is a real fighter.

gloss: to fool, to deceive; to cheat on (a partner)

sentences.text: A mí no me engañas.
sentences.translation: You can't fool me.

sentences.text: Su marido la engañaba con otra.
sentences.translation: Her husband was cheating on her with another woman.

sentences.text: Nos han engañado con el precio.
sentences.translation: We've been cheated on the price.

sentences.text: Con estos guantes no tengo frío en las manos.
sentences.translation: With these gloves my hands don't get cold.

sentences.text: He perdido un guante en el autobús.
sentences.translation: I've lost a glove on the bus.

sentences.text: Para limpiar el baño uso guantes.
sentences.translation: I wear gloves to clean the bathroom.

sentences.text: En recepción te dicen a qué hora es el desayuno.
sentences.translation: At reception they'll tell you what time breakfast is.

sentences.text: La chica de recepción es muy amable.
sentences.translation: The girl at the front desk is very friendly.

sentences.text: Después de la boda hubo una recepción en un jardín.
sentences.translation: After the wedding there was a reception in a garden.

gloss: commission (money for selling); fee (at a bank); committee

sentences.text: Gana una comisión por cada coche que vende.
sentences.translation: He earns a commission on every car he sells.

sentences.text: Este banco no cobra comisiones.
sentences.translation: This bank doesn't charge fees.

sentences.text: Una comisión va a estudiar el caso.
sentences.translation: A committee is going to look into the case.

sentences.text: El vampiro de la película tenía unos dientes enormes.
sentences.translation: The vampire in the film had huge teeth.

sentences.text: Las historias de vampiros me dan miedo.
sentences.translation: Vampire stories scare me.

sentences.text: Dicen que los vampiros odian el ajo.
sentences.translation: They say vampires hate garlic.

sentences.text: Compra una docena de huevos.
sentences.translation: Buy a dozen eggs.

sentences.text: Hoy he recibido docenas de mensajes.
sentences.translation: I've had dozens of messages today.

sentences.text: Me regaló media docena de rosas.
sentences.translation: He gave me half a dozen roses.

sentences.text: Hoy es el lanzamiento de su nuevo libro.
sentences.translation: Today is the launch of her new book.

sentences.text: Vimos el lanzamiento del cohete en directo.
sentences.translation: We watched the rocket launch live.

sentences.text: El lanzamiento del nuevo modelo será en marzo.
sentences.translation: The launch of the new model will be in March.

sentences.text: Técnicamente, no es ilegal.
sentences.translation: Technically, it's not illegal.

sentences.text: Técnicamente, todavía estamos casados.
sentences.translation: Technically, we're still married.

sentences.text: Su hijo es un jugador técnicamente muy bueno.
sentences.translation: Her son is a technically very good player.

notes: física is also a noun: physics.

sentences.text: Hago ejercicio físico todos los días.
sentences.translation: I do physical exercise every day.

sentences.text: Está en muy buena forma física.
sentences.translation: She's in very good physical shape.

sentences.text: Ella prefiere los trabajos físicos.
sentences.translation: She prefers physical jobs.

sentences.text: Una multitud esperaba en la plaza.
sentences.translation: A crowd was waiting in the square.

sentences.text: Lo perdí de vista entre la multitud.
sentences.translation: I lost sight of him in the crowd.

sentences.text: La multitud empezó a gritar.
sentences.translation: The crowd started shouting.

sentences.text: Veo mucho potencial en este proyecto.
sentences.translation: I see a lot of potential in this project.

sentences.text: Esta casa tiene potencial, pero necesita obras.
sentences.translation: This house has potential, but it needs work.

sentences.text: Todavía no has sacado todo tu potencial.
sentences.translation: You still haven't reached your full potential.

sentences.text: Necesito salir de la rutina.
sentences.translation: I need a break from my routine.

sentences.text: Cada mañana sigo la misma rutina.
sentences.translation: Every morning I follow the same routine.

sentences.text: Cambio mis rutinas de ejercicios cada mes.
sentences.translation: I change my exercise routines every month.

sentences.text: Has hecho muchos progresos con el español.
sentences.translation: You've made a lot of progress with your Spanish.

sentences.text: El progreso es lento, pero seguro.
sentences.translation: Progress is slow but steady.

sentences.text: El médico está contento con su progreso.
sentences.translation: The doctor is happy with her progress.

sentences.text: Leí un libro fascinante sobre el mar.
sentences.translation: I read a fascinating book about the sea.

sentences.text: Las estrellas me parecen fascinantes.
sentences.translation: I find the stars fascinating.

sentences.text: Hablar con ella es fascinante.
sentences.translation: Talking to her is fascinating.

sentences.text: ¿Te preparo una ensalada?
sentences.translation: Shall I make you a salad?

sentences.text: En verano comemos ensaladas muy a menudo.
sentences.translation: In summer we eat salads very often.

sentences.text: Hoy solo como ensalada.
sentences.translation: Today I'm only eating salad.

gloss: equivocarse: to be wrong, to make a mistake; to get the wrong (train, number)
notes: Almost always used as equivocarse: me equivoco, te equivocas. equivocarse de tren = to take the wrong train.

sentences.text: Te equivocas, no fue él.
sentences.translation: You're wrong, it wasn't him.

sentences.text: Nos equivocamos de tren.
sentences.translation: We took the wrong train.

sentences.text: Si me equivoco, dímelo.
sentences.translation: If I make a mistake, tell me.

notes: tubo de escape = exhaust pipe.

sentences.text: Siempre dejas el tubo de pasta de dientes abierto.
sentences.translation: You always leave the toothpaste tube open.

sentences.text: El tubo de escape del coche hace mucho ruido.
sentences.translation: The car's exhaust pipe makes a lot of noise.

sentences.text: El agua sale por estos tubos.
sentences.translation: The water comes out through these pipes.

sentences.text: Siempre me interrumpes cuando hablo.
sentences.translation: You always interrupt me when I'm talking.

sentences.text: Interrumpieron la película para dar una noticia.
sentences.translation: They interrupted the film to give a news report.

sentences.text: Perdona que te interrumpa.
sentences.translation: Sorry to interrupt you.

gloss: to represent; to stand for, to show; to make up

sentences.text: Este dibujo representa a mi familia.
sentences.translation: This drawing shows my family.

sentences.text: Las mujeres representan la mitad del equipo.
sentences.translation: Women make up half of the team.

sentences.text: Mañana represento a la empresa en una feria.
sentences.translation: Tomorrow I'm representing the company at a trade fair.

gloss: novel (a long story in a book)

sentences.text: Estoy leyendo una novela muy larga.
sentences.translation: I'm reading a very long novel.

sentences.text: Sus novelas han ganado varios premios.
sentences.translation: Her novels have won several prizes.

sentences.text: Han hecho una película de su novela.
sentences.translation: They've made a film of her novel.

sentences.text: Guardo las herramientas en el garaje.
sentences.translation: I keep the tools in the garage.

sentences.text: ¿Me dejas tus herramientas?
sentences.translation: Can I borrow your tools?

sentences.text: El ordenador es mi herramienta de trabajo.
sentences.translation: The computer is my work tool.

notes: Months have no capital letter in Spanish.

sentences.text: Septiembre tiene treinta días.
sentences.translation: September has thirty days.

sentences.text: En septiembre la playa ya está más tranquila.
sentences.translation: In September the beach is already quieter.

sentences.text: Este septiembre ha hecho mucho calor.
sentences.translation: It's been very hot this September.

sentences.text: Este verano vamos a un festival de música.
sentences.translation: This summer we're going to a music festival.

sentences.text: El festival de cine empieza mañana.
sentences.translation: The film festival starts tomorrow.

sentences.text: Mi grupo ha tocado en dos festivales.
sentences.translation: My band has played at two festivals.

notes: primeros auxilios = first aid. For everyday help, use ayuda.

sentences.text: Oímos un grito de auxilio.
sentences.translation: We heard a cry for help.

sentences.text: Nadie vino en su auxilio.
sentences.translation: Nobody came to his aid.

sentences.text: Hice un curso de primeros auxilios.
sentences.translation: I did a first-aid course.

sentences.text: Después de varios fracasos, el negocio por fin funciona.
sentences.translation: After several failures, the business is finally working.

sentences.text: Para él, sacar un cinco es un fracaso.
sentences.translation: For him, getting a five out of ten is a failure.

sentences.text: El viaje fue un fracaso de principio a fin.
sentences.translation: The trip was a failure from start to finish.

sentences.text: En el castillo todavía hay cañones antiguos.
sentences.translation: There are still old cannons at the castle.

sentences.text: Un puente muy alto cruza el cañón.
sentences.translation: A very high bridge crosses the canyon.

sentences.text: Hicimos una excursión por el cañón.
sentences.translation: We went on a hike through the canyon.

gloss: to set, to fix (a date, a price); fijarse = to look closely, to pay attention
notes: fíjate = look (to point something out or to ask for attention).

sentences.text: Fíjate bien en cómo lo hago.
sentences.translation: Look closely at how I do it.

sentences.text: Los niños se fijan en todo lo que haces.
sentences.translation: Children pay attention to everything you do.

sentences.text: Hay que fijar un precio para la casa.
sentences.translation: We need to set a price for the house.

sentences.text: ¿A quién vas a votar?
sentences.translation: Who are you going to vote for?

sentences.text: Mi nieta vota por primera vez.
sentences.translation: My granddaughter is voting for the first time.

sentences.text: Votamos para elegir el nombre del perro.
sentences.translation: We voted to choose the dog's name.

sentences.text: El parque tiene una zona infantil.
sentences.translation: The park has a children's play area.

sentences.text: Mi hijo solo ve programas infantiles.
sentences.translation: My son only watches children's programmes.

sentences.text: Tiene treinta años, pero es muy infantil.
sentences.translation: He's thirty, but he's very childish.

notes: In Latin America: estacionamiento.

sentences.text: Aquí es muy difícil encontrar aparcamiento.
sentences.translation: It's really hard to find a parking space here.

sentences.text: El aparcamiento del centro comercial está lleno.
sentences.translation: The shopping centre car park is full.

sentences.text: Los aparcamientos de esta zona son muy caros.
sentences.translation: The car parks in this area are very expensive.

notes: I form: ofrezco.

sentences.text: El hotel ofrece desayuno gratis.
sentences.translation: The hotel offers free breakfast.

sentences.text: Me ofrecieron más dinero, pero dije que no.
sentences.translation: They offered me more money, but I said no.

sentences.text: ¿Te puedo ofrecer algo de beber?
sentences.translation: Can I offer you something to drink?

sentences.text: Los esclavos no tenían ningún derecho.
sentences.translation: The slaves had no rights at all.

sentences.text: Me tratas como a una esclava.
sentences.translation: You treat me like a slave.

sentences.text: Es esclavo de su móvil.
sentences.translation: He's a slave to his phone.

gloss: academy; private school (for languages, extra classes)

sentences.text: Por las tardes voy a una academia de inglés.
sentences.translation: In the afternoons I go to an English school.

sentences.text: Mi primo entró en la academia de policía.
sentences.translation: My cousin got into the police academy.

sentences.text: Estas academias ayudan a los alumnos con los exámenes.
sentences.translation: These schools help students with their exams.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo se quedó viudo muy joven.
sentences.translation: My grandfather was widowed very young.

sentences.text: Su madre es viuda desde hace años.
sentences.translation: Her mother has been a widow for years.

sentences.text: El viudo se volvió a casar.
sentences.translation: The widower got married again.

gloss: will (a legal paper about who gets your things)

sentences.text: Mi padre ya ha hecho testamento.
sentences.translation: My father has already made a will.

sentences.text: En su testamento le dejó la casa a su sobrina.
sentences.translation: In her will she left the house to her niece.

sentences.text: Nadie sabía nada del testamento.
sentences.translation: Nobody knew anything about the will.

sentences.text: No hizo caso de mi advertencia.
sentences.translation: He ignored my warning.

sentences.text: Antes de cada viaje, mi madre me hace mil advertencias.
sentences.translation: Before every trip, my mother gives me a thousand warnings.

sentences.text: Que esto te sirva de advertencia.
sentences.translation: Let this be a warning to you.

notes: In Latin America: jugo.

sentences.text: ¿Quieres un zumo de naranja?
sentences.translation: Would you like an orange juice?

sentences.text: Hacemos zumos con la fruta del jardín.
sentences.translation: We make juices from the fruit in the garden.

sentences.text: Se me cayó el zumo en la camisa.
sentences.translation: I spilled juice on my shirt.

gloss: beak; peak (of a mountain); y pico = and a bit

sentences.text: El pájaro tiene el pico amarillo.
sentences.translation: The bird has a yellow beak.

sentences.text: Los picos de las montañas tienen nieve todo el año.
sentences.translation: The mountain peaks have snow all year round.

sentences.text: Llegué a las diez y pico.
sentences.translation: I got there just after ten.

sentences.text: Ese coche amarillo es de mi vecino.
sentences.translation: That yellow car belongs to my neighbour.

sentences.text: Mi hija quiere una bici amarilla.
sentences.translation: My daughter wants a yellow bike.

sentences.text: Pon las flores amarillas en la mesa.
sentences.translation: Put the yellow flowers on the table.

gloss: person in charge, manager (of a shop, a bar)

sentences.text: El encargado nos dejó entrar antes.
sentences.translation: The manager let us in early.

sentences.text: Mi primo trabaja de encargado en una tienda de ropa.
sentences.translation: My cousin works as a manager in a clothes shop.

sentences.text: Él es el encargado de las llaves.
sentences.translation: He's the one in charge of the keys.

notes: encargado is also a form of encargar (to order).

gloss: drama (a serious film or play); fuss, big deal
notes: Masculine although it ends in -a: el drama.

sentences.text: Mi hermana hace un drama de todo.
sentences.translation: My sister makes a drama out of everything.

sentences.text: Los dramas me hacen llorar.
sentences.translation: Dramas make me cry.

sentences.text: Esta serie tiene demasiado drama para mí.
sentences.translation: This series has too much drama for me.

sentences.text: Me tienes confundido con tantas preguntas.
sentences.translation: You've got me confused with all these questions.

sentences.text: Me miró confundida.
sentences.translation: She looked at me, confused.

sentences.text: Los turistas parecían confundidos.
sentences.translation: The tourists looked confused.

sentences.text: El hombre estaba inconsciente en el suelo.
sentences.translation: The man was lying unconscious on the floor.

sentences.text: Estuvo inconsciente dos días.
sentences.translation: He was unconscious for two days.

sentences.text: A veces los jóvenes son muy inconscientes.
sentences.translation: Young people are sometimes very reckless.

sentences.text: Los niños entraron en una cueva.
sentences.translation: The children went into a cave.

sentences.text: En esas cuevas hay pinturas muy antiguas.
sentences.translation: There are very old paintings in those caves.

sentences.text: Dentro de la cueva hacía frío.
sentences.translation: It was cold inside the cave.

sentences.text: Su excusa fue patética.
sentences.translation: His excuse was pathetic.

sentences.text: El final de la serie fue patético.
sentences.translation: The ending of the series was pathetic.

sentences.text: Me vi patético llorando delante de todos.
sentences.translation: I felt pathetic crying in front of everyone.

sentences.text: En abril llueve mucho en el norte.
sentences.translation: In April it rains a lot in the north.

sentences.text: Mi hija nació a principios de abril.
sentences.translation: My daughter was born at the beginning of April.

sentences.text: Normalmente, la Semana Santa es en abril.
sentences.translation: Easter is usually in April.

notes: Plural in Spanish: las matemáticas.

sentences.text: Las matemáticas se me dan fatal.
sentences.translation: I'm terrible at maths.

sentences.text: Mi hermana siempre fue muy buena en matemáticas.
sentences.translation: My sister was always very good at maths.

sentences.text: Necesito ayuda con los deberes de matemáticas.
sentences.translation: I need help with my maths homework.

gloss: to delete, to remove; to knock out (of a competition)

sentences.text: Elimina esa foto, por favor.
sentences.translation: Delete that photo, please.

sentences.text: ¿Has eliminado mi número?
sentences.translation: Have you deleted my number?

sentences.text: Nos eliminaron en la primera ronda.
sentences.translation: We were knocked out in the first round.

notes: causa is also the noun: a cause.

sentences.text: Los móviles causan muchos accidentes de tráfico.
sentences.translation: Mobile phones cause a lot of traffic accidents.

sentences.text: Nadie sabe qué causó el incendio.
sentences.translation: Nobody knows what caused the fire.

sentences.text: Siento las molestias que te he causado.
sentences.translation: I'm sorry for the trouble I've caused you.

sentences.text: No entiendo la función de este botón.
sentences.translation: I don't understand the function of this button.

sentences.text: Esta tarde hay función de teatro en el colegio.
sentences.translation: There's a play at the school this afternoon.

sentences.text: Cada día hacen tres funciones.
sentences.translation: They do three shows every day.

sentences.text: Tenemos placas solares en el tejado.
sentences.translation: We have solar panels on the roof.

sentences.text: La energía solar es cada vez más barata.
sentences.translation: Solar power is getting cheaper and cheaper.

sentences.text: El sistema solar tiene ocho planetas.
sentences.translation: The solar system has eight planets.

sentences.text: Necesito gafas de lectura.
sentences.translation: I need reading glasses.

sentences.text: A mi marido no le gusta la lectura.
sentences.translation: My husband doesn't like reading.

sentences.text: El profesor nos ha mandado tres lecturas para el verano.
sentences.translation: The teacher has given us three books to read for the summer.

sentences.text: Camarero, ¿nos trae otra botella de agua?
sentences.translation: Waiter, could you bring us another bottle of water?

sentences.text: La camarera nos trajo la carta.
sentences.translation: The waitress brought us the menu.

sentences.text: Los camareros de este bar son muy rápidos.
sentences.translation: The waiters in this bar are very quick.

gloss: cabin (of a plane), cockpit; booth, phone box

sentences.text: Antes había cabinas de teléfono en cada calle.
sentences.translation: There used to be phone boxes on every street.

sentences.text: El piloto salió de la cabina.
sentences.translation: The pilot came out of the cockpit.

sentences.text: Hacía mucho frío en la cabina del avión.
sentences.translation: It was very cold in the plane's cabin.

sentences.text: Para mí, el mejor deporte es el tenis.
sentences.translation: For me, tennis is the best sport.

sentences.text: El fútbol es el deporte más popular de España.
sentences.translation: Football is the most popular sport in Spain.

sentences.text: Los deportes de invierno son caros.
sentences.translation: Winter sports are expensive.

sentences.text: El conductor se dio a la fuga.
sentences.translation: The driver fled the scene.

sentences.text: Encontramos la fuga en el baño.
sentences.translation: We found the leak in the bathroom.

sentences.text: La fuga de los dos presos fue de noche.
sentences.translation: The two prisoners' escape happened at night.

notes: darse a la fuga = to run away (from the police, an accident).
Spanish sparkling wine is called cava.

sentences.text: Abrimos el champán a las doce.
sentences.translation: We opened the champagne at twelve.

sentences.text: El champán me da dolor de cabeza.
sentences.translation: Champagne gives me a headache.

sentences.text: El champán francés es muy caro.
sentences.translation: French champagne is very expensive.

gloss: to form, to make; to start (a family, a group)
notes: forma is also the noun: way, shape.

sentences.text: Los dos ríos forman un lago cerca del pueblo.
sentences.translation: The two rivers form a lake near the village.

sentences.text: Queremos formar una familia.
sentences.translation: We want to start a family.

sentences.text: El grupo se formó en el instituto.
sentences.translation: The band got together at secondary school.
